About Adam

Care built on real skill and quiet care.

Adam grew up in Brazil, where he was introduced to bodywork and natural approaches to health and wellbeing from a young age — an interest that's stayed with him ever since. He's also been a competitive long-distance runner for over 15 years, racing marathons and staying closely involved with his local running community, which gives him a first-hand understanding of what a body under real training load actually needs.

He's worked as a professional massage therapist for 6+ years in the UK, having also practised across Europe with a genuinely diverse clientele — from desk workers and weekend joggers to competitive athletes. In that time he's helped clients work through everything from everyday tightness and postural strain to more stubborn, training-related issues: shin splints, IT band tightness and plantar fasciitis, through to old hamstring and calf strains, scar tissue from past injuries, and the deep, recurring muscle knots that build up over a marathon training block.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Adam qualified and insured?

Yes. Adam holds Practitioner’s Diplomas from Gateway Workshops in Chair/Seated Acupressure and Traditional Thai Foot Massage, and is professionally insured through Towergate.

Where do sessions take place?

Sessions take place in Adam’s private treatment room, on a professional table. Mobile visits may be available on request — feel free to reach out and ask. Please note prices may vary for mobile visits.

How do I pay?

Cash is the preferred payment method, taken just before your session — so there’s no deposit to arrange in advance. Card or bank transfer can be arranged instead if needed, just let Adam know when you book.

What is your cancellation policy?

Please give at least 24 hours’ notice where possible to reschedule or cancel, so the time can be offered to someone else.

How should I prepare for my session?

Everything is provided in the treatment room, so there’s nothing to bring. On the day, make sure you’re well hydrated and avoid eating for at least 2 hours beforehand. Please let Adam know of any injuries before you start.
